duration.text: The Stage Performance at Guizhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1527 USD/per year ￥ 11000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate (optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Only those students whose results meet the standard are allowed to take specialty courses, otherwise they are suggested to study Chinese for one or two years.
